subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the refreshed grouped update be approved as one change after privileged-action review, or should the app-token, Codex, Docker publishing, and CodeQL revisions be split into separately validated PRs?
rationale: These actions execute with materially different secrets and permissions, so automation cannot decide whether the grouped review provides enough supply-chain and operational assurance.

options.title: Refresh and approve together
options.body: Recreate or rebase the exact pins on current main, inspect all upstream revisions, and approve the group after dependency and security workflow gates pass.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker publishing, and CodeQL updates so each credential and execution boundary can be validated independently.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve together
recommendation.body: Recreate or rebase the exact pins on current main, inspect all upstream revisions, and approve the group after dependency and security workflow gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects steipete most directly to the Docker release workflow and repository release operations touched by this grouped update.
